svg.title: Chrono system design, as built
svg.desc: Three layers: ingestion sources feed an ETL router that writes to TimescaleDB, MongoDB and Redis; a FastAPI gateway streams Redis messages over a WebSocket to the Next.js dashboard. Status pills mark each part live, partial, demo, broken or planned.
svg.text: DB1 + DB2 share one container: chrono-postgres :5432
* falls back to hard-coded demo data when the live source is empty · globe hubs stay at urgency 0.5 until the classifier publish is fixed
